subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI messages can reach shared context but still not appear in Open WebUI visible chat history

question: Should OpenClaw core own syncing external Control UI turns into Open WebUI's visible chat-history store, and if yes through what supported boundary?
rationale: The remaining fix is not a small local patch: it requires a product decision about third-party persistence ownership, direct SQLite/schema coupling versus an API-supported path, operator opt-in configuration, and whether historical backfill belongs in OpenClaw.

options.title: Design opt-in visible-history sync
options.body: Add a maintainer-approved sync path for future turns with explicit operator configuration, Open WebUI schema/API handling, focused Gateway tests, and `test:docker:openwebui` proof.

options.title: Document unsupported co-editing
options.body: Keep OpenClaw transcript/model context as the owned source and document that Open WebUI visible history is not updated by external Control UI sends.

options.title: Route to integration/plugin design
options.body: Keep core unchanged until an Open WebUI integration or plugin/API boundary can own the external persistence safely.

recommendation.title: Design opt-in visible-history sync
recommendation.body: Add a maintainer-approved sync path for future turns with explicit operator configuration, Open WebUI schema/API handling, focused Gateway tests, and `test:docker:openwebui` proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across Gateway chat persistence, OpenAI-compatible HTTP, and Open WebUI smoke coverage.
